### 12. Contract

Until the values of GAP-2193, GAP-2194 and GAP-2402 are published, the story uses the placeholders and assumed shapes of the sources and builds no code value for them.

disposition.change: Add S8 rows for the screening run, score row per code, contact stop, agent feedback row and breach record, with their key fields as product requirements.
disposition.note: The story names no physical table beyond the one the map holds; the new rows belong in the Ownership Map with the S8 DB story.

disposition.target: Event catalogue and RWB-S8 event contract (EV-06, EV-07)
disposition.change: Carry case key, code, state, contact stop flag, return point and decision record reference in the envelope; no personal or financial value.
disposition.note: Event payload is owned by the S8 contract story; the story side is unchanged.
Harness, fixture pack, test profile, evidence format and gate are in no source and cannot be set without invented values; agree at the wave 2 entry check.

disposition.change: Name the rwb-agent login, publish the S8 raise operation and path with its C row, name the floor, segment and promotion parameter keys, and name the route with the edge owner.
disposition.note: Each open value belongs to the owning contract or platform story; the story keeps its placeholders until then.

disposition.change: Publish the raise operation and decision-entry read with members, path, answer and refusal codes; name the parameter keys, the login and the route.
disposition.note: Contract members and paths are not in any source read; the contract story must publish them at the wave 2 freeze.
Section 12 now states that the story uses placeholders and assumed shapes and builds no code value until the values are published.

disposition.change: Publish the raise and entry-read shapes, register the AgentRunCompleted.v1 payload, fix the gateway-bff route and confirm the five score-row members.
disposition.note: Contract members are owned by RWB-P10-E2029-CON; the placeholder rule for them is now stated in section 12.

disposition.target: RWB-P10-E2029-CON and TSD P7 v2 T-A.1
disposition.change: Publish the decision-log append path and answer, the evaluation and run read field sets, the case-less approval columns, the LOV-DECISION promotion code, the MSG-P7-009 text, EV-30, the DP-02 login and the nine dependency rows.
disposition.note: Wire shapes and value sets are owned by the contract and TSD; section 12 now carries the placeholder rule.

disposition.change: Publish the raise request with the return point, agent version and policy segment fields; name the agent-policy read; add the partial unique index for one open code per case; publish the decision-record envelope type; assign a level to each legacy case.
disposition.note: Request shape, read name, index and envelope type are not in the story and sit with the contract owner and the test workbook.
Covers column aligned to Test Cases v8 for TC-E2-029-02, 04, 05, 06, 07, 09 and 10.
